items.name: Przyprawa rendang
items.detail: Dry warm ochre-brown spice blend of galangal, ginger, coriander, turmeric, lemongrass and chili with a few fine pale coconut flakes. Side accents: sliced pale galangal, lemongrass stalks, glossy makrut-lime leaves, dried chili and a small coconut half. No meat, liquid curry or sauce.

items.name: Przyprawa nasi goreng
items.detail: Dry reddish-brown spice seasoning with garlic, shallot, chili, ginger and coriander. Side accents: purple shallots, garlic cloves, ginger root, red chili and coriander leaves. No rice, eggs, soy-sauce bottle or meal.

items.name: Przyprawa laksa
items.detail: Dry orange-gold seasoning of turmeric, galangal, chili, lemongrass and coriander with tiny pale coconut flecks. Side accents: lemongrass stalks, galangal slices, turmeric, red chili and a little coconut. No noodle soup, shrimp, liquid or food dish.

items.name: Przyprawa tom yum
items.detail: Dry red-orange seasoning with chili, lemongrass, galangal, garlic and small green makrut-lime leaf and lime-zest flakes. Side accents: doubled makrut-lime leaves, lemongrass, galangal, red chili and a green lime half. No soup, shrimp, seafood or liquid.

items.name: Przyprawa pho
items.detail: Fine tan-brown fragrant dry spice blend with cinnamon, star anise, cloves, coriander, fennel and ginger. Side accents: clearly formed star anise, cinnamon sticks, coriander and fennel seeds and a ginger root. No noodles, soup, beef or broth.

items.name: Przyprawa ramen
items.detail: Pale toasted-beige dry seasoning with fine mushroom and ginger powder, garlic granules, sesame, scallion flakes and a few tiny dark nori fragments. Side accents: a dried shiitake mushroom, a small folded dark nori sheet, sesame, garlic and ginger. No noodles, soup, egg or liquid.

items.name: Przyprawa bulgogi
items.detail: Light caramel-brown dry seasoning with garlic, ginger, brown sugar, toasted sesame seeds, black pepper and dried scallion flecks. Side accents: ginger, garlic, scallion stems, sesame and a small cut Asian pear used as a flavour accent. No sliced meat, rice, sauce or meal.

items.name: Przyprawa koreańskie BBQ
items.detail: Dry reddish-tan Korean barbecue spice blend with gochugaru chili, garlic, ginger, toasted sesame and scallion flecks. Side accents: Korean red chili peppers, garlic, ginger, scallions and a sesame scatter. No meat, grill, bottle or cooked food.

items.name: Przyprawa kimchi
items.detail: Dry bright brick-red coarse gochugaru seasoning with garlic and ginger granules and green scallion flecks. Side accents: red chili pods, garlic cloves, ginger and a restrained pale-green napa-cabbage leaf beside the bowl. Bowl contains only dry seasoning, no pickled cabbage, kimchi pieces or liquid.

items.name: Przyprawa do sushi
items.detail: Dry coarse sesame-and-seaweed seasoning with white and black sesame seeds, chopped dark nori flakes and tiny pale salt granules. Side accents: a small folded dark nori sheet, white and black sesame seed scatter and a green wasabi root. No sushi, rice, fish, chopsticks or plates.

items.name: Przyprawa dashi
items.detail: Dry pale beige granular dashi seasoning with finely ground dried kombu and bonito, a few tiny dark kelp flecks. Side accents: a folded brown-green dried kombu strip, thin pale pink-beige bonito flakes and a dried shiitake mushroom. No whole fish, cooked food, broth or liquid; bonito flakes are papery, not rose petals.

items.name: Przyprawa do paelli
items.detail: Dry golden orange-red seasoning with paprika, saffron, turmeric, garlic, parsley and black pepper specks. Side accents: red paprika pepper, a small restrained pile of dark-red saffron threads and purple saffron flowers only at the side, garlic and parsley. No rice, pan, seafood or cooked paella.

items.name: Przyprawa portugalska
items.detail: Dry red-orange piri-piri-style regional seasoning with chili, paprika, garlic, oregano and dried lemon zest. Side accents: slim red piri-piri chilies, garlic cloves, oregano and a cut yellow lemon. No fish, meat, sauce or flag.

items.name: Przyprawa marokańska
items.detail: Fine golden russet regional blend of cumin, coriander, ginger, turmeric, cinnamon and paprika. Side accents: turmeric and ginger roots, coriander and cumin seeds and cinnamon. No couscous, tagine, pottery or cooked dish.

items.name: Przyprawa libańska
items.detail: Dry warm dark tan-brown seven-spice-style regional seasoning with black pepper, allspice, cinnamon, coriander, cumin, clove and nutmeg. Side accents: split nutmeg, allspice berries, cinnamon sticks, coriander and dark cloves. No food or sauce.

ingredient_note: Representative visual compositions for dried seasoning; generic regional blends are artistic choices, not an assertion of a single canonical recipe.
